method.comparator: For each cohort and score, select the fixed expert with the lowest total loss over the entire January-July period. This uses future outcomes and is a hindsight oracle for accounting only, not an admissible forecasting rule.
method.excess: Defensive loss minus oracle expert loss; positive is worse. Monthly excesses and January plus February-July excesses add to the whole period.
method.limits: This decomposition cannot establish that a warm start, different prior, reset, or shorter memory improves future performance. No new candidate, parameter sweep or tuning is performed. The already-explored cohorts are not independent confirmation.
method.protected: Only previously admitted saved predictions and outcomes are read; no source or outcome from 2026-08-01 onward.
method.status: Explicitly post-hoc descriptive diagnosis after the frozen experiment; not a new candidate or registered evaluation.
method.windows: First seven UTC calendar days are nested within January. February-July is the remaining period. Fractions of total excess may exceed one or be negative if later periods offset earlier losses; they are not probabilities.
